note: A migration records an edit to pinned build configuration made after the listed receipts were replayed. It is not a replay: the receipts keep their original pins, timestamps and logs. The verifiers in scripts/replay_fqcd_lean.py and scripts/replay_pr492_lean.py accept a migrated pin only when removing added_text from the current file reproduces replayed_sha256 exactly, and added_text consists solely of whole lean_lib stanzas whose library names and module roots do not overlap a replayed library or module namespace. A fresh replay supersedes these entries.

migrations.reason: TFQ-1055 (PR #496) adds the lean_lib BornGaussianTomographyReduction. The replayed FQCD.StrongCouplingAreaLaw and FoliatedFracton2Gauge libraries, their dependencies and options are unchanged.
